notes.title: Hive Update #13 - Honeycomb arrives November 6, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!


Today we come to you with a bunch of highly anticipated news and trust me when I say that we’re as much excited as you are for this! 


Let’s start with a bang!
We’ve prepared a new trailer just for you! Go watch it! It will be worth it!


[previewyoutube="XUyuqJ8PA3I;full"][/previewyoutube]

Yes we have a release date! Set your calendars for the 6th of November! Finally you’ll be able to explore the wonderful and alien world of Sota7! So prepare your scientific tools, space suit and some headache pills (you’ll need them after cryosleep) and get ready to meet all of those fluffy (and some less so) animals. But survival isn’t all about the cute animals, to do so you’ll need to be prepared to look for drinking water, food sources and most important of all you still need to finish your important mission! So be sure to read that debrief.


Meet our newest supporter!

We’ve got some BIG support from someone who all of you probably know! Please prepare a loud round of applause for Nvidia! With them we’re able to provide you with Nvidia DLSS 4, RTX and RTXDI! I could bore you with all the details on how it works and what it will do to the game but why don’t you see it for yourself!


[previewyoutube="03g1_q5f3JA;full"][/previewyoutube]

I must admit I got mesmerised by the water in that trailer! I know that your excitement is already through the roof but this Devlog is still far from over! Let’s move to the new stuff we’ve implemented to the beautiful world of Honeycomb The World Beyond!

Catch Us at Gamescom!

One more thing! If by any chance you’ll be visiting Gamescom, be sure to check us out! We’ll have our own stand as part of the Indie Arena Booth, and you’ll be able to play a fresh, content-packed demo of Honeycomb before release. Expect plenty of new features to discover, some cool merch to grab, and of course, a chance to chat with the team!

Let’s start with something that I absolutely adore!
As you might remember some time ago we’ve added small critters to the game. I’ve already shown you a rat, a bat and some insects. This time our small guest took a bit longer to get here… I mean how can you blame him!


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfZg93DZe-ZBN29AsBeYV8sAu-jggwOuVFPuVszMmGRNLgjCVQkfA7gNTn1q4jv_CR7dcwnG1QDSEbBUjLN1jAbJoS6pu7QTjfXO2VYFSKsksASp9BRnhwAT0XzLOFHVxtwncMg?key=JJ4de-oDYx0zChoqfiSyXQ"]

And while we’re on the topic of a hardy shell, please welcome the new addition to the big animals in the world of Sota7!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/3d4c453e237d195b6a8b401ae9059adefe4797d5.gif"]


This big ball of scales will be for you to discover in the world of Sota7, all I can share with you is its name - Nango!


Well, speaking of learning and discovering, we’ve decided to change a bit the way you’ll be discovering stuff in Honeycomb: The World Beyond. Instead of using a lab centrifuge, you’ll need to craft yourself a handy scanner to catalogue all those handy (and some not so much) plants.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d5baa2669266214401c13daa129dfb93332acdf2.gif"]But the Scanner isn’t the only tech addition since last time! Perhaps you remember the drones that you’ll be able to fly around with. We have them ready to fly!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c2aeadcf5a3c0fab8cfdd89345193b2fe60ead32.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/dee0e8f24b4d6b90f53441609ff7cd0cb7221ec4.png"]

It wouldn’t be a complete Devlog without our favourite scientist heroine! Now with all the technology provided by Nvidia!


And with that accent, I think it’s about time we’ve finished this Devlog for now…


As always, we hear you and we read everything you say in the comments. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and joining our Discord!


 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png"]



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Hive Update #12 - Climbing Closer!
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!


Long time no see! Another month, another batch of information regarding Honeycomb: The World Beyond! Before we dive into the content of the Devlog, I invite you to join our stream! Jump onto our Steam Page and see the newest changes for yourself!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/"][/dynamiclink]
[previewyoutube="MyX8GSd_H-U;full"][/previewyoutube]
Have you enjoyed it? Good. Now let’s move on to the real content in this Devlog! 
[hr][/hr]Let’s climb to the best of content!
I won’t bore you with the new changes to our technologies or the latest texture optimisation, but I can show you a bit of improvements and new additions to the game!

As the title suggests, we’ve added a new mechanic for you to use while exploring. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c788b8d4981b00946ffec534f0bd1421d85aa318.gif"]

With this, we can give you some more means of vertical exploration in the world of Sota7.

While we’re still talking about exploration, let’s take a quick look at the tools available in your bioengineer arsenal. After all, your legs aren’t the only thing that you’ll need to explore…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/86ea441a2b65332edb95a5916e841da3d9e82cab.gif"]

Let’s move our attention to the new and redesigned station for your future labs! I won’t spoil you with the names of all the machines that you’re about to see, just to keep some of them for you to build when your turn to play comes, but let's be honest, we all remember what our multicooker used to look like!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/8f14c69c78ce3b573c90ac249d568cfe7e035182.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/e2a4ab9417c58a27325e164d6c52f360c2d8bc71.png"]Continuing the topic of redesign and reimagination, let’s take a look at the light and other improvements to our map. Many small changes can contribute to significant transformations!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/77374e9fe963b51175165d9fbe7367733b3251ff.png"]Who would have guessed that Sota7 would look so wonderful!

Exploration goes hand in hand with resource gathering. We decided to upgrade that mechanic as well, adding some new VFX, so it feels more enjoyable to gather those highly needed metals or plants.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d1c94748ff90fd3454b178dffea6e998f2877975.gif"]

I do like those leafy effects!


And lastly, on our agenda is something you haven’t been able to see in the stream (which includes some new content we haven’t shown in this Devlog) and with the new improvements, nights on Sota never looked so wonderful!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2db7536df2d7a93f43366a0fe8c5a216d65070b5.jpg"]

And lastly, it wouldn’t be a Honeycomb’s Devlog if we hadn’t included a Hennessy riding a hoverboard!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d342ae03b5bef07bff98953fa482f6d2b942d976.png"]
[hr][/hr]

As always, we hear you and we read everything you say in the comments. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and joining our Discord!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/456a9f4bbbe96ff6d3ed5f22387f2601452373ca.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png"]

Until the next time!
~Dev Team

notes.title: Hive Update #11: Huge Publisher Changes!
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

We’ve been silent for some time, but the work has been going strong for the past few months. But it all came down to this important message…

Please welcome our new Publishers with a round of applause!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/19dfd663a69a9b6edf239f6e58772330c96ea73c.png

We want to create something special and unique with our new friends at Snail Games USA. They’re the publishers of many incredible titles. But you probably know them most via ARK: Survival Evolved!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/346110/ARK_Survival_Evolved/

With that in mind, we would like to ask you for a bit more time to tie it all together before we publish a unique survival experience for you - our dearest players!

With the important stuff already out of the bag, let’s give you guys a quick development update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7abda503b4e58a36e978c355d9ddd46d7a583c11.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7ce9b971d688b458fa4fda288e790cd435cd7578.png

Next on our agenda are a bunch of new critters that will make the world of Honeycomb: The World Beyond even more alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b4c2e8ec4d0e720811e42934da7de782d1458f22.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ea089a4272e1d3bd95a065c64d8cef456d073193.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/91978bd6a78e2c834115d37aa7e19fa0f92ec9db.png
I need to get a piece of cheese for that cute ratsy creature…🧀 

Our concept artists are also hard at work with new projects that we could bring into the game. Here are a few new projects they’ve finished drawing in the last few weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/50a4f78b7481d1f09af6fb5825a1b313029d2400.jpg
Artificial Nest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/bd5ba68ec678ae41732aea66c6ce1c7d9e51140f.png
What’s Honeycomb without bees? (And butterflies)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/42ca09523348410c04e9e222e9354f64dfab9a39.png
Slime-like critters

In another quick peek, during the last beta test, we were able to gather a lot of feedback regarding the AR mode. From what we gathered, we decided to edit the effects to increase overall visibility within Sota7.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/39667171922db5efd5a10e79dc19a8cc0e70bc0d.gif
Underground veins of ore were never so visible!

[hr][/hr]

And here comes the time to say goodbye… At least for now!

If you want to see our team once again: Here’s a little summary of PAX West we attended at the end of Summer:

[previewyoutube=tWGqmpylRT8;full][/previewyoutube]

That wraps it up for today. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and join our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png

Remember that Science is an art!
~Jacob and Honey Team

notes.title: Dev Update #10 - OUR FIRST EVER STORY TRAILER! & STEP-BY-STEP SURVIVAL GUIDE!
notes.notes:
Hello, Explorers!

As you know, EON Corp. is working hard to make Operation Honeycomb a success. That's why, today we'll share some of the key elements of our game with you.

In this devlog, you'll discover essential survival techniques to navigate and tame the alien and dangerous fauna and flora of Sota7.  We'll also focus on introducing our concept of condition, health, and knockout  in the game. Stay tuned for some tips and tricks for enduring the challenges of Sota7 and ensuring your survival in this hostile environment.

NEW TRAILER

We have to announce that our FIRST EVER STORY TRAILER is here, ready for you to uncover. It's time to show you an introduction to our story. Get a glimpse into Hennessy’s life and the mission she’s embarked on. Discover why the game is set on an alien planet instead of the Earth. Check it out and unveil the mysteries that await!

[previewyoutube=Etg6fnoAV_w;full][/previewyoutube]Your opinion is always welcome in the comments section! Thank you!

SURVIVAL FEST

Dear Explorers! As you know, Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival game, and on May 27th, we'll be participating in the Open World Survival Crafting Fest on Steam with a commentary stream about the game's features.

On this occasion we'd like to shine a brighter light on  our survival mechanics and explore the whys and wherefores of how we treat them the way we do.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/06e84a1b01d7cd0ab999260d80f8b0e0c438fa9a.png

NEW MAP

Step into the new world with us. Much has changed since you last glimpsed Sota7 in our devlogs.
We hope this will be a fresh start for you in exploring this land, awakening your curiosity as researchers navigating through this unique planet, with even greater enjoyment.
Check out a few takes of what’s new, and let us know how you feel about it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/6ce72a2f25f9df90ae0c330cc529755891c9dba1.gif

SURVIVAL GUIDE

CONDITION

In our game, we focus on Condition and taking care of Hennessy to avoid unnecessary risks. This system directly impacts your character's endurance, allowing you to conduct essential research efficiently – your lifeline in this world.

How does it work?

As a player, you're in charge of her, and your actions can push her to the brink. If stamina drops too low, she risks a knockout – our unique take on character death in the game.

Time may heal wounds, but not entirely. After a while, you'll regain consciousness, but the effects of your carelessness will linger, affecting your performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/4515ff35b6ec817c3d2b88af10b5662a38af5161.gif

We designed this system to make the player think strategically, like a real survivor trying to prevail despite the harsh conditions. Taking care of Hennessy is crucial, and you'll be rewarded for it. However, every reward has its flip side. A knockout is a serious setback; limping back to base in a weakened state is no walk in the park, and can be downright perilous.

As an experienced bioengineer, survival is your top priority. Charging at bears with bare fists? Not so much. It's all about smart decisions and staying one step ahead of the dangers that lurk around the corner. Remember, always keep healing items on hand – they can be lifesavers.

THIRST AND HUNGER

As we mentioned before, keeping Hennessy healthy is our top priority. But what if you head out without any supplies?

You can always try depending on foraging for sustenance. Sota7 has some wild plants and fruits – though not all of them are safe. Almost everything is edible, but some might give you a nasty surprise.

If it comes to thirst, remember to craft a smoothie, tea or even energy drink to not pass out.

So, gear up before you go exploring. We've got two tools to help you out: the Cooker, which makes even toxic antus edible and tasty like a gourmet meal, and the Water Dispenser, which turns river water into crystal-clear hydration, perfect for those hot days.

Stay prepared and keep Hennessy in top shape - without energy, there is no exploring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/a7a5b2313d168896dc9aaa51278ee748f520ba48.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/5e7c3ffd1591a90d08a42310f1584d3974f966b1.gif

STAMINA

Even though Hennessy is a trained bioengineer on a tough mission, she’s not a robot and has her limits. One big limit? Stamina. 

Basic tasks and intense activities tire her out. You can easily recharge energy by standing still and resting.

But after a long day, she needs a solid dose of sleep, which she can only get back at the base. So, planning your day wisely will yield the best results.

There are ways to cheat the system, though. Consuming certain supplies can let her go without sleep for longer, but be ready to face the consequences – they’ll mess with Hennessy’s well-being.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/052eb22f9813dadf26b495a3481cdbdbba05ea7f.gif

AIR CONDITIONS

Okay, let’s gear up a bit, shall we? We’ve got a useful tool to help Hennessy face toxic air. Keep her lungs safe by crafting a Gas Mask, allowing you to navigate polluted areas freely… For some time. Just remember, it won’t last forever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ff9f1abb694ba76dac7dec08670a585352154307.gif

Do you want to dive deep and stay submerged longer? Craft yourself a Rebreather! This gadget boosts your underwater breathing time, but don’t forget – it’s got its limits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/bdca74803508c1a62fc881d844cd44c87037beb8.gif

HEALTH MANAGEMENT

Ready to face the wilds? Diseases and injuries can sneak up on you, so having some basic medical know-how is crucial. Risking critical condition is (almost) never worth it.

There are two kinds of medicaments in our game. Light meds, like herbal tea, are great for minor issues or a quick condition boost. You can prepare them with relative ease in your Cooker, and you’re good to go.

For serious stuff, you’ll need advanced meds that require an aid station. Think bandages and painkillers – perfect for the bigger injuries and keeping Hennessy in top shape. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f10a123d81adbb4f1f892517ef22f7b7791fdd3f.gif

SNEAK PEEK

In one of our previous updates, we presented a model of our heroine. Today, we'd like to show you a glimpse of her animated expressions. Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f6b1343c633a9a11a66a63b307a417f6501b3a2e.gif

KEEP UP TO DATE 

We survived, Explorers! We hope our approach to condition and the reasoning behind our health system is now clear. Remember, Hennessy is our main protagonist, and taking care of her is your top priority.The tips and tricks we've shared today should help you as you explore the planet Sota7. We believe you'll handle any danger that comes your way like a pro bioengineer!

Wrapping things up, we invite you once more to watch our story trailer, and join us during survival fest!
As always, our social media channels are open for you to stay in the loop with the latest news.
If you like Honeycomb: The World Beyond make sure to add it to your wishlist as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/

For the finale - here's our Discord server so feel free to join us there and be closer to the devs than ever before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png

Have a nice day, and remember…

Science is an art!

notes.title: Dev Update #9 - Crossbreeding facts you have to know!
notes.notes:
Hello explorers! 

It's been a while since we last saw each other and we’re happy to meet you again! 

With the first blooms the spring came back, making the days longer, warmer, and brighter. 
We felt inspired to share a development update focused on a pivotal game mechanic: crossbreeding. 
Cherishing the sunny days, we’ll focus on plants, leaving the animal section for later. 
For those who are eager to deepen their knowledge about our game, this video-devlog is for you! 

[previewyoutube=zjTYJHQ81-Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Crossbreeding, though a fascinating mechanic, comes packed in layers of complexity and restrictions. Not all actions are allowed, and not every experiment leads to success. We're here to gently steer you through the dos and don'ts, paving the way for your success as a bioengineer! However, we won't reveal everything — maintaining an air of mystery is essential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b83435adc5dc78f60eb8500f30ed74276800e594.png

KEEP UP TO DATE

We hope that you've gleaned some insight into the nuanced world of plant crossbreeding in our game. It fills us with excitement to gradually reveal the many mysteries of Honeycomb to you. If certain facets have sparked your curiosity, we're eager to hear from you on our social media platforms — our team is ready to engage and share more with our vibrant community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440

Psst!

For those who love being in the know ahead of time, we've got a little sneak peek of our next devlog for you. After all, we haven't mentioned anything about animals today, have we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/762ba9cdd6cd2cbaea2896e090bf576b6cdaa1f9.jpg

As always, we encourage you to enhance your wishlist by adding Honeycomb and invite you to visit our Discord. There, you'll discover exclusive content and will be able to interact more closely with the team working on the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png

Stay curious and remember,

Science is an art!

Team Honey~

notes.title: Dev update #8 - PC and Console release date, and NEW trailer!
notes.notes:
Hello Explorers!

We hope your journey to Sota7 is smooth sailing, and you've settled into a comfy seat. 
We're sending you a crucial update straight from the ship, courtesy of Hennessy herself. In this message, you'll learn about a significant change in the release date, as well as added subtitle to our game, key art change, and console news… 
We encourage you to stay with us until the very end.
 
Thanks and wishing you a pleasant journey, Team Honey~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c86784a28f3420a6432a8df2c930a1f31717f19b.gif

WHAT’S NEW

Getting to the heart of the matter, we wanted to share a very important message with you. Be assured that we made this decision keeping the project's best interests in mind and ensuring everything is locked in place. We hope you understand, but we've chosen to move the Honeycomb release date to Q3 2024.

We understand that it's not the first time we've adjusted the release date, but with the complete vision of the Honeycomb project in mind, we want to deliver the game to you in its full glory.

This adjustment is driven not only by the commitment to launch the complete game instead of early access but also by a major announcement we've been keeping under wraps...

It's BIG NEWS for both us and console players! Alongside the full PC version of Honeycomb, we'll try to launch the game simultaneously on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S!

We wanted to make sure players on all platforms will be able to embark on this journey at once.

We hope you understand our decision, and perhaps it'll add a bit of sweetness with our new TRAILER, diligently prepared for you over the past few weeks:

[previewyoutube=bQ9f7WgSTos;full][/previewyoutube]

KEY ART

Just as bees breathe life into our planet, we've decided to infuse new life into our capsule. Hennessy stands in the glow of dawn over Sota7, looking out beyond the horizon. Her time is now, and the world is full of new things for her to discover. It's time to embrace this boundless space, leaving behind her symbolic cradle.

On Sota7, Hennessy has a chance to encounter life forms that don't necessarily conform to her expectations and enjoy much more freedom than she ever did living in the safe enclosures offered by the ARKs back on Earth.

NEW SUBTITLE

After much back-and-forth within our team, we've decided that our game could use a subtitle to better capture the essence of what Honeycomb is all about. But before we dive into that, let's kick things off with a fundamental question - why did we call the game Honeycomb in the first place? 
Our most important inspiration for the game is nature and the role it plays in the survival of our planet and frankly, without bees, mankind would be gone in less than five years.

Since our game mechanics are so closely tied to the natural process of cross-pollination and humanity’s continued struggle to survive against all odds, “honeycomb” represents Earth, a place that humanity built up as its cradle. It’s a safe, well-known space, but also a closed and limited environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/e7e6cc62ba7478b207298a89541f4e0f2bf559cd.gif

The subtitle we’ve chosen complements the main title and points to the other core mechanic of our game - exploration. “The World Beyond” is what we’d like to invite you to see for yourselves - a realm that stretches beyond our comfort zone, surpassing the cradle. Sota7 is a door to that limitless, unfamiliar place – a world filled with captivating discoveries and potential hazards, inviting us to venture into the unexplored.

Inspired by the addition of a new subtitle, we also opted for a subtle change in the logo. We aimed to highlight Art Nouveau elements in a more sci-fi-inspired style. The delicate floral motifs on the lettering signify vegetation, while the centrally placed letter Y resembles a capsule containing plant life.
We're curious to hear your thoughts, so be sure to let us know in the comments what you think about the new visual direction of our logo.

KEEP UP TO DATE

So… that's a wrap for today, Explorers. We hope you like the changes and share our excitement about the console and full PC release in Q3 2024. We're aware that this is another delay, but we want to make things right.

As always we encourage you to visit and follow us on social media, and wishlist us on Steam Page as well. But if you’re curious about some exclusive content, check our our Discord server, by clicking on the banner below, or HERE.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png

Science is an art!
Team Honey~

notes.title: Honeycomb general update #5 – It’s animation time! Let’s get into the wildlife
notes.notes:
Hello, Explorers 🧭

It’s time for another development update, and today we’ve got a pretty cool pack of news for you. As always, I’d like to thank you for your comments here on Steam, on our social media, and Discord server. Before we proceed to the world of Sota7, I'd like to mention one significant thing. As you may know, a few months ago we announced co-op mode for Honeycomb. In this devlog, I have an important announcement to make on this subject, so be sure to read till the end to know all the details.

Hennessy

To start today's development update with a high note, let me introduce you to our heroine. She’s a real bioengineer, skillful and brave enough to take part in the operation Honeycomb. Say hello to Hennessy! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/61a70bffe04ed4202f5b8bfdcb9e7bc17fbe5fef.png

Biomes

It’s time to reveal more about the world where our adventure will take place. As you probably know, Sota7 is a vast planet full of diverse biomes, each full of character. Dive into exploration and experience plenty of new plants and animal species waiting around the corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7f9f71d0395cc45162a84d2cd9a929071a0c37ff.png

Fauna and animations

On Sota7, you’ll find various species of bizarre animals. Today, I’d like to show you how some of them come to life with our little animation showcase. Shall we start our journey through wildlife?

Say hello to our Striders, they’re very relaxed fellows who like to chill and enjoy calm days. Don’t get too close: they may run away!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/6cbfb8d661f999e1a41eca803b77c4d09c1ecdc7.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/143b26390b8d8439ddf2136ed03c52a0de6e5690.gif

Okay, Explorers, now try to keep quiet. This feline animal is swift and not too fond of company. Don't try to lure it with “here, kitty, kitty”. It won't work.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/59f24c282487b7d4a2002a4438efd4a601bb3473.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/5dd741c9861fb0325fbc0cc69f44703f0875263b.gif

The next resident of the Sota7 is this big, bearish-looking boy. As you can see, he likes to relax and enjoy his rest, so let’s not disturb his peace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/56c8fe39ff5b2a8cab6559beebd4e94774168a7b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/6903e48b075ea53dffe2040c797d868b9f1b6405.gif
His commanding presence belies his docile temperament. He might look angry, but he is a member of a very peaceful species.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/920eb0fcda16470d0d84eee3392d506ac6ee98a4.gif

In our first ever development update, you might have seen an image showing one of our first animals. Now It's time to present how they move, run, walk, and lie down. Aren’t they super cute?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/6433e2fe5328b3332022931c5a36592e1a0a51ae.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b43a5861eb77667de33352c6202748015196d987.gif
Now let’s move on to another cute animal from the world of Honeycomb. Let me quote our compendium to give you a better perspective on its character profile: 

These adorable critters belong to the Mustelideae family, the same as weasels and otters. They’re somewhat elusive creatures – they certainly don’t wait around to find out your intentions! They feed primarily on fish and as such can be found near water sources”.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1b37819cb1554661d3304673f87b594bdbcc9556.png

Flora

I could say “Welcome to the Jungle”, but truthfully, it’s more like a Japanese cold forest. I invite you to explore the world of Sota7 vegetation. 

That's the very first stage of the growing process of our two plants: Antus and Succulent. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1a0ff32a5aee0b1a0ef70e67698626e5a8c2201f.png


Antus: In the image below, you can see 3D models presenting 2 plants from the same family and the effect of the allogamy process (for more information about crossbreeding mechanics, you can check our previous devlogs). Colobantus is the effect of mixing Diantus and Amantus, however the final look still remains a mystery 🤫
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/03711e74f927dc55d00508cca2f16d9b66d0ce46.png

Succulents – As we’re still working on our plant database, this succulent doesn't have a name yet, but its crossbreeding process is the same, as for the previous one. How would you name them? Feel free to give your suggestions in the comment section.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ae87da7dfb32fb85317ddf9d6f4c81c677e8b857.png

As if this wasn’t enough, we’ve prepared two more Flora representatives. Those trees are two varieties of the Filoy, which you can find on our planet. Its fruits are a little sour and crunchy, not that tasty… Wouldn’t recommend it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/0ee0ad7a64f77c7243d8e544925a27ea8df4cad5.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/20e1c37d6a13e42a363b70b040c87017523ca72c.gif

Co-op mode

After extensive discussions about how the implementation of co-op could affect the player experience, we’ve made the difficult decision to stop the development of co-op features for Honeycomb. We came to the conclusion that ultimately we care more about exploring more ideas in-depth instead of spreading ourselves thin working on both single player and co-op, especially in a new engine. This is all to ensure that you get the most fun out of our game – which is why I am certain you’ll understand this decision. Our priorities remain the same – listening to your feedback and answering your questions. Please leave them in the comment section or join our Discord channel by clicking HERE.

Keep up to date

Okay, we’ve come to the end of this development update, Explorers. I hope that you’ve enjoyed today’s news and understand our decision towards Co-op mode. We really care about your opinion, so don’t hesitate to share it in the comments section below. If you want to keep up to date, wishlist us on Steam and follow our social media. See you in the next devlog! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/ 

Honey Team~

notes.title: Honeycomb dev update #4 - Technology design - our journey so far 🛰️
notes.notes:
Hi there, Explorers! 🧭

It’s been a while since we let you in on the latest in Honeycomb. That’s because we’ve been toiling away like a bunch of busy bees! In fact, our Technology Designer needs a break… And would like to tell you about the fruit of our efforts and how we got where we are. There’s plenty to learn, so without further ado - let’s delve into the world of tech design and find out how one comes up with what trees should look like… You can also look forward to a small surprise that awaits you at the end of this devlog - we’re hosting some visitors from above, and it’s not what you think it is!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/be4163d42c4071fb95ad6c2d98bc5d50d46f9b7a.png

Tech design isn’t all about numbers - technology has a feel and an aesthetic to it. We all know a chunky computer from the 80s gives a very different vibe than a MacBook - and video games are all about feeling. So we decided on a unique style from the get-go, and we’re working to incorporate it into every piece that appears in-game. A futuristic take on Art Nouveau doesn’t mean just throwing in some sci-fi elements into existing designs, however. Our designers work in accordance with tenets of the art movement -  putting emphasis on fluidity of lines, flowing and sinuous motifs, and floral shapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/74e3f8c7937072892dfe0ea5996cdccc357f59be.png

Our Technology Designer translates his ideas into 3D right away, no sketches required. Above you can see the effects of an exercise he did when we just started working on defining the style of our game.. He transformed the look of a typical chair from IKEA and designed its sci-fi and Art Nouveau counterparts, drawing attention to the most characteristic structural elements. The next step was to blend these extremes until he felt like he had the perfect model. After that, we had a solid base for any future designs and could just follow a similar workflow. Easy-peasy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/357f027df1728a463c25897a7a547d732200fdf8.png

Above are presented a few stages of base development. You can read more about it in our previous development update.

FACILITIES

Soon after we’ve created the base, we shifted our focus to base operation(s). All that tech (...and the bioengineer) has to run on something!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/64daa26dde5b67e05c3feb61279495d23666ae94.png

Silo consists of a water container and a power accumulator. It’s how you’re going to conserve these precious resources for a rainy day. We tried to make it blend in with the base while also giving it a distinct look by drawing inspiration from the Tesla coil - you can see it in the glowing sphere on top!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/0c00badfb00a1dbf8756aa7ccde111ee3a8b1ce1.png

At first, solar panels were supposed to look like ship sails but over time their shapes started looking more and more flower-like. In the end, they are very similar to blossoms. Solar panels will supply energy to your base… Talk about flower power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/78702e4f883d315c9d72fecdac6dda4db0b72556.png

Another one of our facilities is the Antenna. In this project, our Technology Designer used organic design motifs, which he considers to be a contemporary version of Art Nouveau. The Antenna will create a radiolocation area, allowing the players to use crucial mechanics such as the Drone Hive.

DRONES

A lot of mysterious places and valuable materials are waiting on Sota7 to be discovered by you. You need to expand your base to find them all! Thankfully you won't have to rely only on yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b64b706ad88a8b5505579620e72de497322a0c87.png

Drone Scout is a companion which will support the Explorers as an extra pair of “eyes”. With its help you can observe a diverse world of Sota7 from a bird’s eye view and explore uncharted territories. The design of this device is based on flexible and flowing shapes. Openworks structures and magnetic engines replaced conventional drive mechanisms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/a16f92ef9eac856891738e30de4c2291f266e3b0.png

Drone Builder is a gadget which allows the player to construct the base on a basic level. When working our Technology Designer was inspired by car keys. Drone Builder’s form is closely related to the style we used for the base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/9275d1f4dad74c9bb49ae1f93baa5a4053f063df.png

Drone Engineer is the biggest and most functional drone in the game. It works in cooperation with the Drone Hive. Engineer lets the player construct a base in planning mode, while the Hive contains two smaller constructing drones that build it. A source of inspiration was of course the beehive. 🐝 In a way, the Engineer is like the queen bee who orders the worker bees from the Hive around.

VEHICLES / MEANS OF TRANSPORT 

Sota7 isn’t just a planet - it’s a planet that needs to be thoroughly explored. You can go where your feet take you or sit back in one of your vehicles and enjoy the trip through remarkable areas. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/a7424859b210ac48644d007e70a8ebe60e7ee418.png

Hoverboard is the smallest available vehicle. It allows you to move quickly from one place to another. Its construction was heavily influenced by organic design. We wanted to design something that would incorporate openwork elements, an electromagnetic engine and would still look like something that could be transformed into a smaller device. That’s how we landed on this branch-like model.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b13cc73c9d75fb5f07274a35ff1634a2854f6f36.png

Buggy is a medium size vehicle with cargo space. During development the concept of the Buggy went through a lot of metamorphoses. All of this ultimately contributed to the creation of this vehicle with an electromagnetic drive and openwork supporting structure. Our Tech Designer disclosed that he looked at a lot of fish pictures while designing this thing. We decided not to question him further.

AN ASSORTMENT OF ODDITIES

If that’s not enough to convince you that we’ve been pretty busy, we’d like to show you some more odds and ends. We can’t really put them in their own neat categories, but they are indeed pretty neat. Just take a look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1a36f31e1d84e3f555934f4f172b2a2f3baf4f6e.png

Vertical Farm is a device which allows you to breed plants in laboratory conditions. As for functionality, the concepts don't differ from each other. As you can see, this apparatus has a double structure and a UV lamp. Like the previous ones, this project was inspired by the base design as well, especially in terms of its supporting structure. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/9474913dad0742f81f3c24976c07cac6e9fde32a.png

Shhh, it’s alright… Just sleep. Yes, this is exactly what it looks like. The injector is a tranquilizer dart gun. Killing or hurting the animals isn't part of your mission on Sota7, but that doesn’t mean that you’re supposed to stay far away from them… or that they’ll always be friendly. Thanks to the injector you can obtain samples from dangerous species without harming them, or them harming you. Our Technology Designer considers it one of his favorites. He said this design went through a lot of changes, but he ended up really liking it… Which isn’t always how it works out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2c5f576adc788405058c37c8d085ce7b1720f027.png

If you’re still craving more after all this excitement, you can take a look at our friends’ devlog about their game, Aloft - a sandbox survival indie where you have to survive in a world threatened by an eternal hurricane.

Steam Base Builder Fest. As you might expect we’ll participate in Steam Base Builder Fest. Look at the stream we’ve made for this occasion! We hope that you’ll like the new mechanics we presented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c09daf382ee2662adce8f24a10841a0809ae5d3a.png

KEEP UP TO DATE

Alrighty, that’s it for today, Explorers. We hope that you found this devlog interesting. We are all looking forward to your comments! Your opinion means a lot to us.
Once again, we want to invite you to Honeycomb’s Discord Server, because it’s important for us to stay in touch with you. You can also follow us on our social media outlets to keep up to date. 

Finally, we’d like to encourage you to add Honeycomb to your wishlist and to follow the game, so that you’ll be kept informed about future updates of the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/?l

notes.title: Honeycomb Dev update #3 – Welcome to the LAB! It’s experimentation time!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Explorers 🤠

How are y’all doing? It's been a great time of creative experimentation for our team lately, and today we'd like to show you the fruit of our efforts. Last devlog was full of building-themed stuff, and now I’ll take you on a journey to the world of bioengineering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/52cf42e9a0d98dcd6a7d1bf843b71b286b248baf.png

Before we start, I’m curious how you liked our new trailer. If you haven’t seen it yet, you can watch it HERE ⬅️

Without further ado, let’s get to the lab!

MECHANICS

We’ve already introduced you to crossbreeding plants and animals. Today, I’d like to bring you even more details and show unique experiments for Honeycomb. First of all, I’d like to show you three growing stages of plants and trees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/4948f005a7df12947fc2b3d3426a8a333d129228.jpg

As a bioengineer, we’ll use three mechanics: Allogamy for flowering plants, Grafting for trees, and Environmental Changes for fungi. We must focus on the right conditions. Without them, the process won’t go well. Prepare your seeds, samples, and keep the water supply close at hand. We want our little ones irrigated, don’t we? 

Allogamy

Now let’s focus on Allogamy – the most basic form of experiment in Honeycomb. It’s almost impossible to mess it up.
Why is that so? You could ask. Have you heard of bees and the amazing work they do! They fly from flower to flower, carrying heavy stuff on their little legs - they're the key agent in this process! Pollen, transferred between plants, can make new variations or species. In our game, it will look a little similar, but it'll need your assistance.

What you see in the picture below is a hybrid called the former. Formers change not only their shape but their pigment, parameters, and even their behavior as well. On the other hand, you have fillers - hybrids that only change pigment or parameters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/4991ca18c802b71bd6d5740607f825fe3fb4d29e.jpg

Here’s an example of the animation – work in progress! — and how the experiment will look. Let us know what you think of it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/fbf85b91549aa498c2253be30bf8d4d64d6f592b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/a6017617729c1199ca7c0a6566b35b343af4d5c7.gif

But even here there are some restrictions. Allogamy only occurs in plants that produce flowers and are currently in bloom. That's your task to find the right one.

Grafting

Okay, guys, we've made it this far. With the basics out of the way, I can show you the next challenge. The following experiment won’t be that simple, though. This time, we’ll have to observe the results on our own. Your job is to place a branch on a tree grown in the lab and make a compatibility check. If it’s the right branch it will grow mutated fruit, but if it’s incompatible, the fruit will stay the same, and you’ll have to start all over again. Let’s assume everything went fine and jump to the final step. It’s time to break the mutated product into seeds from which new species can develop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c875b10ccbbf39346a80292ba66fcca0a0fddce4.jpg

Also, enjoy our work-in-progress animation of the grafting process:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2d891504c04a8248b223fd29fda16c0a52af5957.gif

ENVIRONMENTAL CHANGE

Okay, now that the verdant world of plants is behind us, we can focus on fungi. Now it's time for and adventure. Gather some environmental samples, you’ll need them to make changes to the fungi’s growing process. That's the most challenging type of experiment you’ll do in Honeycomb. It depends on a few conditions, and you’ll have to focus on completing it correctly. Before you start, you need to change the parameters of experimental chambers for your sample to mutate. Otherwise, the mutation won’t begin – risk is an inherent part of change, after all. Let’s see how far your imagination can take you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1fb54c0ef889716b2df1eeb83b1b60c72b020fdf.jpg

EXPLORE OUR MEDIA

Aaand that would be it for today's development update, Explorers! I hope you felt the vibe of what being a true bioengineer entails and liked our experimental showcase. Last but not least, we’d love to invite you to our discord server, which gives access to exclusive content we don’t publish anywhere else. Just click HERE or on the banner below to join! ⬇️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2c5f576adc788405058c37c8d085ce7b1720f027.png

We’re very excited to hear how you feel about our work, so share your thoughts in the comments and let us know if you enjoyed the devlog! Remember to follow us on our social media and wishlist us on Steam for upcoming updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/ 

Leave the cradle and start exploring!

~Team Honey

notes.title: Honeycomb Dev Update #2 - Gather, Build, Survive with release on Q4, 2023!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow Explorers!

It’s been over a month since our last update, and we’re back with unexpected NEWS! We’d like to announce that The Honeycomb will release in Q4 of 2023! If that isn't enough, we also want to share a fresh and new trailer that is all yours!

[previewyoutube=sz3HEFO5Sdc;full][/previewyoutube]

However, before we go any further, it’s time for the second announcement of a crucial matter. Honeycomb Official Discord Server is NOW LIVE! If you've ever felt like joining the community, we think this is the time. We always wanted to connect people and create a place where they could discuss our game and become closer to us. We’ve thought sharing our concepts and development stage through the Discord server is a first-class idea. Furthermore, we wanted to invite you to take part in making the game. We want to hear your voice quicker than before.

So, what’s left is to click the banner below and say hello, because you're all welcome!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2c5f576adc788405058c37c8d085ce7b1720f027.png

Steam Page News

Moving ahead, we have another BIG NEWS. As you may know, we’re constantly in the development phase, and it’s consuming most of our time. During last month, we challenged ourselves to redesign our entire steam page: starting from a capsule through descriptions to the screenshots. So, take a look at the new capsule, and feel free to join us by clicking HERE or  on the graphics below, and share your opinion of how you find the changes in the comments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7f5f6e5ea17fd69e2a7091452f7e71a234c8b735.png

Without further ado, let’s get to the building, shall we?
In this devlog, we’d like to introduce you to our base mechanics. That also includes our inspiration for its style, some aspects you can use during the planning mode, and much more. Are you ready? Then let’s go!

INSPIRATIONS

As we’ve mentioned in the last development update, our game is set in the distant future, and the Earth is going through an Eco–Apocalypse. That’s why we’ve wanted to create a unique style for our buildings. We’ve decided to mix classic sci-fi and the early XX century french design, Art Noveau. We’ve thought that those two opposites will create the perfectly combined style, where high-tech and domination of floristic details will show humanity yearning for nature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/487f67797ba79ec24dc1d4d860f345ae539632b5.png

PLANNING MODE

The planning mode is something fresh and new. As you can see, it allows you to plan your base - structures locations, possible connections and all modifications. Apart from that it gives you all the information about the building process (f. ex. Building order, time) and resources that are required to build it. The hologram shows you what it’ll look like when it's ready so that you can design your dream base

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/300b04b6ab8234f6aa9647c837fbf05c869908be.gif

THE CREATION

Ready with your resources? Now you can sit, watch, and trust the process. That’s the power of automated building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1f4dca0e45c8424ea8ae29916f3cd5e8445f260d.gif

The base is not the only thing you can plan and have built automatically. We still work on different parts of the design, such as doors, stairs, windows, or furniture.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1a520851ed89223e32836fd6dbf3a1443ecc78bd.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/57479c7cbc978b1605cb4c8cfc08cb14014e496f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f5012826485d70718ee0d802d48482f6c49b35c8.gif

You can click the video below if you'd like to dive into a more detailed analysis of our inspirations for the style, planning mode, and automated building. Our devs, Bartek and Marko, will be pleased to know that you’ve checked it out.

[previewyoutube=TcDFwHe4Wwk;full][/previewyoutube]

FEEDBACK NEEDED

Because our creations are significant to us, and we believe you deserve a part in their development, we need your opinions and feedback, Explorers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b32f8b296b6d890c5adfaaa9195aa7d06b967763.png

We'd like you to share your thoughts about our planning mode and automated building process. Have you ever seen something like this before? 
We'd also want to know what possibilities, as a player, you can see while looking at these mechanics. 
Your ideas are much anticipated, the comment section is yours!

KEEP UP TO DATE

As additional info, we’d like to announce that we’ll participate in PGA – Poznań Game Arena. If some of you don't know, that’s a polish gaming event in Poznań between the 7th-10th of October. You can visit us there, say hello and play our first ever build for players. We’re also wondering how many of you we’ll meet, so let us know.

So, that would be it for today, guys. We hope that you liked our base-themed devlog so as the big announcements. We'd like to remind you, that Honeycomb will release in Q4 2023, so stay tuned. We also want to invite you to join our Discord Server once again to stay with us closer than before. You can also check our social media to keep up with the date.

Last but not least, you can add Honeycomb to your wishlist as well as follow the game if you want to get notifications about future updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

PS: Explorers, here’s a little sneak peek for you! Your opinion about the cooperation mode in Honeycomb would be an asset, so let us know, what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2019f35a7aafcf4734d016d4908acc90bfdaed6c.gif

~Team Honey

notes.title: Development update #1 - First look at the world of Honeycomb
notes.notes:
The Earth as you know it has ceased to exist. The Eco-Apocalypse is here and now. The once vibrant animal kingdom, lush forests, vast seas and oceans have been lost in the abyss of nothingness. The natural resources from which we drew so much are gone irreversibly. Forced by unfavorable conditions on the surface, people moved to underground cities, leaving behind the splendor of the sun and the beauty of the blue sky. Now, only a sizable ozone hole yawns above their heads, showing the scale of the changes that have taken place on our planet.

Years have passed and science has reached the edge of its capabilities. After many attempts, the mighty heads have mobilized the nobles of this world to undertake a risky experiment. This project is the last salvation for the planet, as well as for human development itself.

Out of many, the daredevils were chosen. Training in preparation for the expedition was exhausting and stressful, but it was successful. Finally, we can say it: it's time to explore the unknown world!

The long flight was not one of the most pleasant, but Hennessy arrived at her destination. Here is where the adventure begins, explorer. Dive into the new world and rush towards the unknown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/54a44c4bd246340f60e8c028748b710a2b3221bd.png

Sup, Explorers!

Welcome to the first ever development update of Honeycomb! 

In this development update, we'd like to show you some cool concept arts that we've already prepared. Additionally, we'll explain a little bit why the development is taking so long. Last but not least, we'll showcase you some really great animations and a little sneak peek of what you can expect from the upcoming update. This time has been busy for us, but now we want to share a little piece of our creation. Adventure into the unknown begins now, explorer. Don't hesitate and dive into the marvelous world of Honeycomb.

What’s taking so long

We know it's been a long time since we announced Honeycomb, so it's time to bring you some answers. As a bioengineer, you get to experience a vibrant and colorful world. It's all about feeling free and being able to uncover this untouched land as you wish. There are a lot of things to pay attention to, so keep your eyes open if you don't want to miss the clues! We also want to share that special feeling of what it's like to be a real scientist. That's why we’re composing such a complex ecosystem to evoke a sense of authenticity in you.

To better introduce you to the theme of our game, we'd like to mention the term – crossbreeding. It works on the principle of a Taxonomic tree, so it is important to remember that it is impossible to combine incompatible species from different families. You will study how and which elements of flora and fauna will give the expected combinations. Furthermore, we’ll give you many opportunities to genetically crossbreed those plants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2caa541a16a93ab3ac691270241ff6841bbbd376.png

In addition, here you have some ideas of underground fruits. You can expect different textures, which we’re working on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/15934a54d4a1e5888fcf933897e30bdc424c6d00.png

When it comes to crossbreeding of animals, the case is a little different from plants. We won't play with their genes, because we're concerned about ensuring that they're not harmed. That's why crossbreeding occurs naturally, by animals pairing up with each other in the wild. However, there is also your role in the whole process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c5c6f7c4ed2e47155df98ed4c88fb0e0f534230e.png

What is more, we’ve been working on the tail physics. Check it out below and let us know what you think of it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/5ddc91e44571f57fc0b891bafd43e9aef76d34c4.gif


As you can see, we've prepared some ideas for creatures and plants already, and many more are yet to come. But we don’t stop here – it’s time to present to you another stuff we’re constantly working on. Say hello to the amphibian animal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/72cd1d695ffed7281664078bae629a65500eb421.png
We think it looks cool and majestic, but a little clumsy. Just look at this cute tongue sticking outside its mouth. So adorable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b1d0c0735c297575377019e4253b4ec7305906cc.png

If you have dulled your eyes with the appearance of our creature, you may also like the animation of its movement, which we’re constantly improving.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/43345a1da0b6eead9b2bba2994c8a3e124215751.gif
